# OpenThesis v1.0.0-alpha.3

Windows-first architecture preview with a modular React workbench, isolated
Python JSON-RPC research core, native Tauri platform operations, smoother
interruptible navigation, retry/history/SEC-help parity, and a no-install
portable Windows package. macOS build, signing, notarization, and runtime
validation remain a separate pre-1.0 gate.
